blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur — Anti-narcotics agents arrested two suspected drug dealers and seized around 50 grams of suspected shabu worth P340,000 during a buy-bust operation in Barangay Sta. Isabel, Dipolog City, Zamboanga del Norte, on Nov. 6. In a report released Saturday evening, the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA) Regional Office 9 identified the suspects by their aliases “Rene,” 51, a resident of Montevista, Davao de Oro, and “Mike,” 57, of Datu Paglas, Maguindanao.
